sections.shortTitle: Additional Attorney-General Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Terms and Conditons Rules 2011
sections.section: RULES - Additional Attorney-General Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel (Terms and Conditons) Rules 2011
sections.description:
ADDITIONAL ATTORNEY-GENERAL, DEPUTY
ADDITIONAL ATTORNEY-GENERAL, DEPUTY
ATTORNEY-GENERAL AND STANDING COUNSEL
(TERMS AND CONDITONS) RULES, 2011
(Amendment of R.2)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II,
3rd April, 2013]
S.R.O.277(I)/2013, dated 28-3-2013.---In pursuance
of subsection (2) of section 2 of the Central Law Officers Ordinance, 1970 (VII
of 1970), the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased to
direct that in the Additional Attorney-General, Deputy Attorney-General and
Standing Counsel (Terms and Conditions) Rules, 2011, the following amendments
shall be made and shall be deemed to have been so made from the 11th March,
2013, namely:--
In the aforesaid Rules, in rule 2, for clauses (b)
and (c), the following shall be substituted namely:--
"(b) Deputy Attorney-General
(i) monthly
retainer--one hundred fifty thousand rupees.
(ii) chauffeur
driven car of 1300 CC capacity with monthly one hundred fifty liters petrol or
monthly ten thousand rupees.
(iii) monthly
telephone ceiling for office, no limit and for residence, up to one thousand
five hundred calls with mobile charges, two thousand rupees.
(iv) monthly
house rent allowance--twenty thousand rupees.
(v) medical
allowance--as admissible to a BPS-20 officer.
(vi) travelling
and other allowances--as admissible to a BPS-20 officer, when required to
perform his official duties to leave the place where he normally practices his
profession.
(c) Standing
Counsel
(i) monthly
retainer-one hundred thousand rupees.
(ii) chauffeur
driven car of 1000 CC capacity with monthly one hundred fifty liters petrol or
monthly ten thousand rupees.
(iii) monthly
telephone ceiling for office, no limit and for residence, up to one thousand
five hundred calls with mobile charges, two thousand rupees.
(iv) monthly
house rent allowance--twenty thousand rupees.
(v) medical
allowance--as admissible to a BPS-20 officer.
(vi) travelling
and other allowances--as admissible to a BPS-20 officer, when required to
perform his official duties to leave the place where he normally practices his
profession.".
